title: Workouts Explorer / Operational
description: AUTOGENERATED by deploy/grafana/generate.cjs. Based on the 10/5/2026 live metric audit; no synthetic profile or private product data. Namespace and Environment filter newly labeled Go API/workers as well as native nginx, Martin and collector self metrics. Legacy bare exported_job history retained in Thanos lacks namespace/environment labels and remains unscoped: its environment is unknowable from the series; only earlier xdev deployed metrics are known.

panels.description: Open Operational or Historical in the same tab, retaining Namespace and Environment selections. Each view uses its default time range.

options.content: OperationalHistorical

panels.title: API request rate by status
panels.description: API route templates only; excludes health probes. Observed HTTP attempts are not logical operation availability.

panels.title: API 5xx percentage and GET latency (p95)
panels.description: 5xx fraction is an observed attempt ratio, not an accepted availability SLO. No traffic or absent 5xx stays N/A. GET latency includes fast errors; routes are templates. 500 ms is provisional.

custom.axisLabel: Seconds; 500 ms provisional guide, not SLO

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le,http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="otel-gateway-collector",exported_job=~"workouts-api|${service_namespace:regex}/workouts-api",service_namespace=~"${service_namespace:regex}|",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}|",http_route=~"/api/.*",http_request_method="GET"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (http_route) (sum by (http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="otel-gateway-collector",exported_job=~"workouts-api|${service_namespace:regex}/workouts-api",service_namespace=~"${service_namespace:regex}|",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}|",http_route=~"/api/.*",http_request_method="GET"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: API mean body size
panels.description: Bytes actually read/written, including measured zero-size bodies. Sum/count gives mean bytes per observed HTTP request, not bandwidth.

panels.title: UI request rate
panels.description: Native stub_status requests include status/probe traffic. No route/status/latency or browser-error instrumentation exists.

panels.title: UI connections by state
panels.description: active is TOTAL; reading/writing/waiting are its breakdown. Lines are not stacked or summed. Connections are not requests or users.

panels.title: UI connection rate
panels.description: Accepted minus handled is a resource-limit connection signal, not HTTP errors. Real zero is retained; absent series are not filled.

panels.title: API tile-forwarding outcome rate
panels.description: Write errors can have HTTP 200; use outcome, not just 5xx. Kinds route/coverage are bounded; no capability IDs or concrete coordinates.

panels.title: API and Martin latency (p95)
panels.description: Three independent populations: API GET handler includes auth/validation and response handling; API forwarding starts before Martin and ends after body processing/write, excluding auth/capability renewal; Martin native measures successful backend GET tiles (200 or 204), excluding proxy and browser render. Never subtract or add p95s. 500 ms is a provisional performance guide, not an accepted SLO.

custom.axisLabel: Seconds; 500 ms provisional guide, not SLO

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le,tile_kind) (rate(workouts_api_tile_duration_seconds_bucket{job="otel-gateway-collector",exported_job=~"workouts-api|${service_namespace:regex}/workouts-api",service_namespace=~"${service_namespace:regex}|",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}|"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (tile_kind) (sum by (tile_kind) (rate(workouts_api_tile_duration_seconds_count{job="otel-gateway-collector",exported_job=~"workouts-api|${service_namespace:regex}/workouts-api",service_namespace=~"${service_namespace:regex}|",deployment_environment=~"${environment:regex}|"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Martin successful tile request rate
panels.description: Native GET route template only; both 200 and valid-empty 204 are success. This is not the API forwarding population.

panels.title: Martin tile 5xx request rate
panels.description: No native 5xx combination was observed in the final audit; absent is N/A, not zero. Local scrape up is not whole tile availability.

panels.title: Coverage timing (p95)
panels.description: Queue age is creation-to-first-claim (not oldest backlog age); matcher measures Evaluate only; route measures postclaim attempts including cleanup, not durable completion; admission measures the polling loop. Histograms have no measurement dimensions. Sparse observations preserve gaps. Source-defined sparse Coverage instruments; all eight were absent in the 10/5/2026 six-hour audit. N/A is not zero or an empty backlog. Outcomes observe confirmed committed terminal transitions, not an exactly-once ledger; crashes, ambiguous commits and DB-only reconciliation are omitted. no_evidence can be valid; superseded/cancelled are not automatically failures.

panels.title: Coverage outcomes
panels.description: Source-defined sparse Coverage instruments; all eight were absent in the 10/5/2026 six-hour audit. N/A is not zero or an empty backlog. Outcomes observe confirmed committed terminal transitions, not an exactly-once ledger; crashes, ambiguous commits and DB-only reconciliation are omitted. no_evidence can be valid; superseded/cancelled are not automatically failures.

panels.title: Coverage control rate
panels.description: Admission denied counts polls, not distinct queued routes; lost renewals are rejected renewals, not necessarily incidents. Separate operation/result labels, never sum into failures.

panels.title: Coverage retry and stale-rejection rate
panels.description: Retry kinds overlap and omit attempts failing before metadata load; do not sum as distinct jobs. Stale rejections are ownership-fenced terminal rejections, not completion.

panels.title: Database client operation rate
panels.description: Client operations, not server QPS or jobs; operations from both pools merge within each service. No pool dimension exists on DB duration/errors.

panels.title: Database client mean duration
panels.description: Sum/count mean only. Current seconds buckets overwhelmingly cover (0,5]; subsecond DB p95 is not meaningful and is intentionally omitted.

panels.title: Database client error rate
panels.description: Errors exclude no-row results; batch callbacks can yield multiple observations. Not failed-job counts. Worker counters were absent in the audit, not measured zero.

panels.title: Pool connections and capacity
panels.description: Fixed pool names distinguish app/OSM/diagnostic pools. Total includes constructing + acquired + idle; independent lines are not stacked. Configured max is not an SLO.

panels.title: Pool contention and connection churn
panels.description: Empty acquires are successful acquires that waited; cancellations are not failed jobs. Destroy/open counters describe connection lifecycle.

panels.title: Pool mean acquisition and wait time
panels.description: Duration counters are nanoseconds, converted with /1e9 before division. Means use successful acquires / successful empty acquires respectively; no histogram or pool-specific p95 exists.

panels.title: Go runtime memory
panels.description: Go stack/other memory and GC goal are not RSS/container working set. Finite runtime memory limit is optional and was absent in the audit. Namespace and Environment filter newly labeled Go API/workers as well as native nginx, Martin and collector self metrics. Legacy bare exported_job history retained in Thanos lacks namespace/environment labels and remains unscoped: its environment is unknowable from the series; only earlier xdev deployed metrics are known.

panels.title: Go goroutines
panels.description: Runtime activity on API/general/Coverage workers is not evidence of owned job progress. No app CPU, uptime or GC pause instrument is installed.

panels.title: Go allocation rate
panels.description: Cumulative heap bytes and allocation counts are differentiated before aggregation. Positive allocation rates indicate producer activity, not completion or CPU usage.

panels.title: Collector CPU usage
panels.description: Only UI/tiles sidecar collector processes, not nginx/Rust/Go app CPU. CPU-seconds rate gives used cores. Preserve origin service_instance_id, never gateway pod.

panels.title: Collector memory and allocation rate
panels.description: RSS has no _bytes suffix but is bytes; heap is not RSS. Allocation rate uses the audited runtime_alloc_bytes_total name, not the vendor fixture name.

panels.title: Collector metric flow
panels.description: Accepted means handoff, not delivery; sent counts successful point sends, not HTTP requests/jobs. Native and self pipelines share exporter otlp_grpc; counts need not match end to end.

panels.title: Collector metric errors
panels.description: Receiver refused/failed are separate point signals, not distinct loss. Exporter send_failed/enqueue_failed are UNOBSERVED CANDIDATES, absent at source/host in the audit, not zero. Send attempts may retry; failed self-export can hide its own warnings. Pair with host probes/logs/gateway evidence.

panels.title: Collector exporter queue
panels.description: Current exporter sending-queue size/capacity for otlp_grpc in configured queue-sizer units, not application backlog or a count of lost telemetry points. Keep per-origin identity. Queue size/capacity were actually 0/10 in the audit, not fabricated defaults.

panels.title: Scope and interpretation
panels.description:
- Namespace and Environment filter newly labeled Go API/workers as well as native nginx, Martin and collector self metrics. Legacy bare exported_job history retained in Thanos lacks namespace/environment labels and remains unscoped: its environment is unknowable from the series; only earlier xdev deployed metrics are known.
- The gateway pod is not application origin. Collector self CPU/RSS and local scrape health do not represent application or Job health.
- Missing or sparse observations display N/A with gaps, not invented zeros. Worker HTTP measures probes, not ingest traffic.
- Dates use America/Los_Angeles. These views contain no accepted SLO, error budget, inventory exporter or private account/health data.

panels.title: Data availability: 30 days
panels.description:
- Live retention updated 10/6/2026: Thanos raw samples are retained for 2 days.
- Five-minute downsampled data is retained for 14 days; hourly data for 30 days.
- Retention is an availability ceiling, not a guarantee of complete stored blocks or short-window latency detail. Verify datasource routing and query warnings when interpreting older data.
- Historical defaults to 7 days, with time-picker suggestions through 30 days. Longer manual selections may contain little or no retained data; no automatic range clamp is applied.
- Daily plots use rolling 24-hour increases evaluated at one-day steps, not exact Los Angeles calendar-day ledgers. Missing days remain gaps; a 14-day sample window does not guarantee completeness.

panels.title: History limitations
panels.description:
- No backlog/oldest-job/slot state exporter, owned ingest/scheduler/file outcomes, nginx latency/status/browser metrics, DB server exporter, OSM/hook Job metrics or authorized SQL inventory reader exists.
- No accepted two-week SLO, Pyrra resources, burn rates or error budgets are installed. The 500 ms latency guide is provisional, not an availability commitment.
- Host infrastructure mapping is not inferred from the gateway pod. Coverage timings and terminal outcomes are sparse observations, not queue state or an exactly-once ledger.
- No accounts, health values, coordinates, private capability IDs, SQL or raw errors are queried. Only bounded route templates and fixed pool names are used; scope variables are not access control.
